free_tier.stated: Free plan, EUR 0.00: 1,000 requests a month, no hidden fees and no credit card; an access key is issued after an account is created
free_tier.notes: Basic is EUR 9.99 a month (EUR 7.99 billed yearly) for 100,000 requests and Professional EUR 49.99 (EUR 39.99) for 1,000,000. Past the monthly allowance the API answers HTTP 403 usage_limit_reached.

per_object_cap.stated: a bulk lookup takes up to 50 IPs as a comma-separated list; a single lookup takes one

egress.terms: not applicable: JSON or XML answers, not metered in bytes

interface_detail: GET https://apiip.net/api/check?ip={ip}&accessKey={key} answers JSON or XML; a comma-separated list of up to 50 IPs does a bulk lookup on plans that include it; check without an ip parameter looks up the caller
tooling: any HTTP client or the vendor's client packages for JavaScript, Python and PHP
chaining: 1,000 lookups a month with location, currency, language, time zone and security modules is a test allowance; the paid plans are the working route. Bulk path: bulk lookup of up to 50 IPs on plans that include it; whether Free includes it is unverified.

limits.value: 1,000 requests a month on the Free plan; HTTP 403 usage_limit_reached past it
100 requests per second from a single IP address; HTTP 429 too_many_requests past it
up to 50 IPs per bulk lookup request

binding_note: 1,000 requests a month is met long before the 100 requests a second rate.

identity_cost.detail: an account is needed for the access key; the sign-up form has account details, billing details with a country selector and company details; no credit card is asked on the Free plan

reliability_note: past the monthly allowance the API answers HTTP 403 usage_limit_reached and past the per-second rate HTTP 429 too_many_requests; a keyless call answered HTTP 401 missing_access_key
confidence_note: The plan list, documentation, FAQ and sign-up page were quoted on 2026-11-02 and a keyless call answered HTTP 401; no keyed lookup was made. The plan list as rendered does not show which modules the Free plan excludes, and the account-detail fields of the sign-up form are rendered by script, so whether Free includes bulk lookup and which account fields are required are unverified.
